title: Ben Rich's deathbed remarks to Jim Goodall
summary: Jim Goodall tells of Ben Rich's deathbed remarks to Jim Goodall, about 1995 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He said, "Jim, we have things out in the desert." And he wasn't referring to Area 51.
We have things out in the desert that is 50 years beyond what you can comprehend.
tellings.difference: Adds that the things are '50 years beyond what you can comprehend' and gives the date as c. 1993-1995.
tellings.link_reason: This is Ben Rich's remark to Jim Goodall that 'we have things out in the desert', the same deathbed conversation.

as_told.title: Ben Rich: 'we have things out in the desert'

plain: A man named Jim Goodall says he spoke with Ben Rich, the former head of Lockheed's secret aircraft design shop, Skunk Works, near the end of Rich's life in 1995. According to Goodall, Rich told him, "Jim, we have things out in the desert," and Goodall says he did not mean Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, but somewhere beyond it. If true, it would point to even more hidden sites holding secret technology.
